Fact: design_rationale
What to find: How and why key design choices in training were made.
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Design

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Safety fine-tuning was designed to give developers a readily available, safe and powerful model that reduces the workload needed to deploy safe AI systems, and to give researchers a resource for studying safety fine-tuning robustness. Design choices: data collection combined human-generated vendor data with synthetic data to mitigate safety risks; LLM-based classifiers were used to select high-quality prompts and responses; there was emphasis on driving down refusals to benign prompts, including borderline and adversarial prompts in the safety data.
quotes: The primary objective of conducting safety fine-tuning is to offer developers a readily available, safe, and powerful model for various applications, reducing the workload needed to deploy safe AI systems.
We employ a multi-faceted approach to data collection, combining human-generated data from our vendors with synthetic data to mitigate potential safety risks.
We’ve developed many large language model (LLM)-based classifiers that enable us to thoughtfully select high-quality prompts and responses, enhancing data quality control.
We included both borderline and adversarial prompts in our safety data strategy, and modified our safety data responses to follow tone guidelines.
